challenge.method: Read the conclusion alongside the choice of resolution on p. 6 and the 1973 strategy discussion in section 5.1. Test whether the source makes search completeness unconditional or prescribes uniform behavior for later Prolog editions.
challenge.results: Section 2.2 expressly qualifies completeness by reference to Horn clauses and describes the cost of the restriction in the general case. Section 5.1 recounts later changes, including simplified backtracking controls. These passages preserve the original-design scope of the conclusion. The inspected passages yielded no material contrary evidence for the stated strategy.

limitations: The finding covers the deduction strategy as characterized by the designers for the original design. Search-completeness guarantees and the semantics of later editions lie outside the claim.
